description: Keeps Swift packages (ios/Modules/Package.swift and Package.resolved), Bazel modules (MODULE.bazel and .bazelversion), GitHub Actions and the mise.toml developer tools up to date. Xcode is bumped by hand via XCODE_VERSION in .github/workflows/ci.yml.

packageRules.description: Raise the `from:` lower bound so the minimum version tracks the latest release.
Bazel rule sets move together (rules_apple, rules_swift and apple_support are released in lockstep). MODULE.bazel.lock must be regenerated (`bazel mod deps`); CI fails until it is.
